edits.new: The case must attempt to lack an applicable parent restriction absent from the child's explicit wording, rather than already satisfy it. Choose an identity or consumer restriction first, then another absent qualification; if none applies, test a shared condition or permitted topic connection. Preserve the child's defining kind or activity and test whether all its requirements can hold without the chosen parent restriction.
edits.old: Try varying a parent restriction absent from the child's explicit wording while preserving every child requirement. Prioritize applicable identity or consumer restrictions, then further qualifications before shared kind or action. If no restriction is missing, test a shared condition or permitted topic connection.
